name: Apollo.io
description_en:
Apollo now presents data, intelligence and execution as connected layers. Workspace handles prospecting, outreach and dialing; Apollo Anywhere brings functions into existing tools. Its AI Context Center is intended to ground agents in the company’s ideal customer profile, products and playbooks. These are documented capabilities, not evidence that an agent will identify qualified buyers correctly.

An illustrative rollout is to define a target segment, review a prospect list, enrich the necessary contact fields, and enroll the approved contacts in email outreach. Connect only the CRM and mailbox needed for that test. The pricing FAQ says free accounts can connect Gmail, while paid plans allow Microsoft Office or other providers. Validate field matching and reply handling before using agent-generated lists at scale. No workflow was executed here.
description_zh:
Apollo 当前把数据、智能与执行描述为相连的三层。Workspace 处理找客户、触达和拨号；Apollo Anywhere 把能力带入现有工具。AI Context Center 用于让智能体理解公司的理想客户、产品与销售手册。这些是文档能力，不代表智能体一定能正确识别合格买家。

可用以下方式评估：定义目标群体，审查候选名单，补充必要联系字段，再将批准的联系人加入邮件触达。只连接测试所需的 CRM 与邮箱。定价 FAQ 说明免费账户可连接 Gmail，付费套餐允许 Microsoft Office 或其他供应商。大规模使用智能体生成名单前，应验证字段匹配与回复处理。本次没有实际执行流程。

core_features.explanation_zh: 在 Workspace 中处理找客户、触达与拨号。

core_features.explanation_en: Pool credits and monitor usage by user.
core_features.explanation_zh: 共享额度并按用户监控使用。

Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: An illustrative rollout is to define a target segment, review a prospect list, enrich the necessary contact fields, and enroll the approved contacts in email outreach. Connect only the CRM and mailbox needed for that test. The pricing FAQ says free accounts can connect Gmail, while paid plans allow Microsoft Office or other providers. Validate field matching and reply handling before using agent-generated lists at scale. No workflow was executed here.
steps.zh: 可用以下方式评估：定义目标群体，审查候选名单，补充必要联系字段，再将批准的联系人加入邮件触达。只连接测试所需的 CRM 与邮箱。定价 FAQ 说明免费账户可连接 Gmail，付费套餐允许 Microsoft Office 或其他供应商。大规模使用智能体生成名单前，应验证字段匹配与回复处理。本次没有实际执行流程。

items.en: Standard plans are for internal business use. The pricing page explicitly says powering external products, sharing data with customers or reselling requires a separate agreement. Annual billing commits to twelve months; moving back to monthly requires waiting for the annual term to end. If renewal payment repeatedly fails the account may be downgraded. Inspect credit usage by user and set caps before an enrichment job, rather than assuming “unlimited” removes operational limits.
items.zh: 标准套餐用于企业内部。定价页明确说明，用数据驱动外部产品、向客户共享或转售，需要单独协议。年度计费承诺十二个月；改回月付需要等待年度期限结束。续费多次失败可能导致降级。执行数据补充任务前，应按用户检查额度消耗并设置上限，不能把“无限”理解为没有运行限制。

items.en: Apollo fits teams wanting a shared data and outreach workflow, especially when existing tools need the same account context. It is broader than a mailbox sequencer, but does not remove the need to validate CRM ownership, targeting and data rights. Public pages describe a hosted service; self-hosting and source licensing were not established. Regional availability, real data accuracy, failed-action recovery and AI approval controls remain purchase-specific evaluation gaps.
items.zh: Apollo 适合需要共享数据与触达流程的团队，尤其是现有工具需要一致账户背景时。它比单纯邮箱序列工具更广，但仍需验证 CRM 归属、定位与数据权利。公开页面描述托管服务，尚未确认自托管与源代码许可。地区可用性、真实数据准确度、失败动作恢复及 AI 批准控制仍需按采购场景评估。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The official pricing FAQ describes Free, Basic, Professional and Custom, but the retrieved view did not expose reliable payable amounts. Credits are pooled for the team and reset each billing cycle without rollover. Purchased add-on credits also expire and automatically recur until removed; the page tells users to return the add-on slider to zero before renewal. A trial is separate from the ongoing free Starter plan. All seats on an account must use the same plan level.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方定价 FAQ 说明 Free、Basic、Professional 和 Custom，但本次可读页面未提供可靠的实际应付金额。团队共享额度，每个账期重置、不结转；购买的附加额度也会到期，并持续自动续购，直到移除。页面提示在续费前将附加额度滑块调回零。试用与长期免费的 Starter 不同。同一账户所有席位必须使用相同套餐等级。

official_check.scope: Primary public pages only; no identity claim, pricing approval, independent review, hands-on testing or publication approval.
